character: fat male honeybee drone, amber, barrel belly, honey-smeared; a white headband reading ИПОТЕКА in black capitals from frame one; exactly six legs, front pair as arms; two thirds of frame height
cast: exactly three worker bees in white aprons, purple, teal, orange; two in white headbands reading КРЕДИТ and ДОЛГИ in big black capitals, the third blank; words flat and unbent on the cloth; aprons and bands stay on all clip; they work large at the lens, never talk
motion_rule: the drone is the subject of every window, the bees add to his move; no window ends in a pose; shot size never repeats
props: spoons of honey; a jar he empties on himself; pillows bursting into feathers; honey runs off him
environment: honeycomb bedroom at noon, direct sun, hard shadows; bed buried in white pillows

audio.delivery: lazy smug male voice, native Russian stress, unhurried
audio.pronunciation: доход is do-HOD, stress on the last syllable, never DO-hod
audio.pacing: one phrase from 0.6 to 3.6, no breath at any join, nothing said after 3.6
audio.lip_sync: jaw and lips shape every syllable, never a voice-over

timeline.a: he kicks a pillow into the lens, blanking it, honey flying off his belly
he sinks deeper into the pillows, a bee driving a spoon in his mouth
he throws both forelegs open across the frame, honey ropes flying off
he heaves his body off the pillows and drops it, the bed bouncing him twice, two bees riding the pillows with spoons
he rolls onto his back, belly wobbling the whole width of the frame
he snatches the jar off a bee and upends it over his face, honey pouring into the lens
he hammers both forelegs into the burst pillow, punching feathers into the lens, feathers stuck to his honey
the purple bee catches his foreleg, drops a shoulder under his belly and throws him over her back, his body flipping, pillows exploding
he crashes on his back, she lands astride his chest and pins him flat, the other two pinning a foreleg each at the lens, his band knocked crooked
she locks both forelegs on his throat and bares her teeth in a snarl, her face filling the frame, teeth flashing in the sun, her КРЕДИТ band right at the lens
timeline.c: macro on her snarl, pushes in

timeline.a: his eyes bulge, he groans through the choke, his belly bucking the bed under her, honey squirting out, the other two riding his legs down
timeline.c: close, slides off her onto him

timeline.a: his palm crashes down on the bed twice, tapping out, honey splashing up, her snarl over him
his palm slides at the lens and fills the frame, honey draining through the fingers

must_appear: ИПОТЕКА on the drone band from frame one; КРЕДИТ and ДОЛГИ on bee bands, readable; the shoulder throw; her sitting on his chest; the snarl close-up with teeth; his palm slapping the bed; last frame is his palm filling the screen
negative_prompt: night, dim light, static camera, cuts, a talking head, the drone motionless, bees standing in a row, garbled or misspelled words, Latin letters on the bands, no other words, more than three bees, the bees out of frame, subtitles, English speech, voice-over, the phrase repeated, any word after 3.6, extra legs, deformed anatomy
